about.registeredLine: Registered in Lahore, serving all Pakistan
about.paragraph: Founded in Lahore in 2021, Aasra Welfare Society began with an unwavering conviction: that every orphaned child and impoverished family deserves equal access to safety, clean water, education, and compassion.
about.pillar1Text: Excellence in every ration delivered, every well installed, and every orphan raised.
about.pillar2Text: Direct photographic and location documentation provided to donors for every project.
about.learnMoreLink: Learn about our mission, leadership & registrations

donateSection.title: How to Send Your Donation
donateSection.subtitle: We offer multiple transparent, 100% verified avenues to contribute your Sadaqah, Zakat, and donations from Pakistan and across the world.

card1.title: Online Donation
card1.descShort: Donate via Credit/Debit Card or Direct Transfer.
card1.descFull: Donate via Credit / Debit Card (Visa, MasterCard, Apple Pay) or direct Bank Makramah transfer with instant receipt.

card2.title: Mobile Wallets & Raast
card2.desc: Transfer instantly from your EasyPaisa, JazzCash, or Raast instant pay ID with zero transaction deductions.

card3.title: Pay Cheque via Mail
card3.descPrefix: Make a crossed cheque payable to
card3.descSuffix: and mail it directly to our registered Lahore office.

card4.title: Doorstep Pickup
card4.desc: Our authorized representative will personally visit your home or office in Lahore to collect cash or cheque with an official receipt.

quote.text: "The example of those who spend their wealth in the way of Allah is like a seed of grain which grows seven ears; in each ear is a hundred grains."

zakatSection.title: Purify Your Wealth with the AASRA Zakat Fund
zakatSection.text: 100% of your Zakat goes directly to verified eligible (Mustahiq) orphans, widows, and families living in extreme poverty across Pakistan, strictly adhering to Sharia principles.
zakatSection.nisabNote: If your net savings exceed this threshold for one lunar year, Zakat is due at 2.5%.

1.text: Community dua ceremony marking the handover of a new hand pump, one of over 170 water points installed by AASRA across Punjab.

2.title: Wheelchair Distribution Recognition
2.text: Recognised alongside allied welfare organisations for distributing wheelchairs to persons with disabilities in flood-affected communities.

3.title: Annual Result & Achievement Day
3.text: Our orphan students were celebrated for their academic achievements at the annual result day ceremony, held with games, prizes and gifts.
